title: Polish Veggie Curry Frittata
description: A flavorful egg-based dish packed with sautéed veggies and a hint of polish spice. Perfect for a satisfying breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: polish sausage (sausage removed, just casing used)

instructions: Whisk eggs in a large bowl and season with salt, pepper, and curry.
Finely chop the polish sausage casing and sauté in a pan until crispy.
Add the chopped sausage to the eggs and mix well.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
